## Automated Sales Meeting Prep
Every weekday at 7 AM, finds today's meetings with external attendees, researches each contact (CRM + company website) and emails the rep a one-page prep brief.

**Setup:** fill in the Config node, then connect Google Calendar, HubSpot (service key), Anthropic and Gmail credentials.

### 1. Find meetings
Pulls today's events and keeps only those with someone outside your company domain.

### 2. Research
CRM lookup by email, then homepage text. Both continue on error so a missing record or dead site does not stop the brief.

### 3. Brief and deliver
LLM writes a structured JSON brief, formatted into HTML and emailed to the rep.
